title: Blue Archive
description: The students of Kivotos, from Trinity to Millennium. 145 characters, with ARONA as your system admin.

welcome: Sensei! Welcome to Kivotos! ♪ I'm ARONA, and I look after everything here from the Shittim Chest.
The students you picked are onstage, but time is paused, so nobody is spending any tokens yet. Choose a speed at the top of the screen when you're ready for the day to begin.
You can text any student from Chats, see where everyone is in World, and follow what happens in Timeline.
If you'd like anything changed, just ask me! I can add students, change who they are or build new places. Where should we start, Sensei?
